title: P1: re-deliver pre-archive candidate coverage
rawUserRequest: Execute the remaining authorized plan to convergence. Fix process defects in the current Work Item rather than creating temporary patches or unnecessary successor Work Items; do not bypass gates or release before the final audit. The user authorizes execution and requires that authority to be recorded in every Contract.

declaredIntent.summary: Redeliver #672 from current main with a complete scope: prove the actual uncommitted archive candidate, bind coverage into Outcome and archive manifest, and reject ambiguous foreign worktree state.

outOfScope: Mutating, archiving, or rewriting the frozen #672 Work Item or any historical Contract, Summary, Outcome, or archive manifest.
Weakening coverage floors, accepting a path-only candidate digest, bypassing archive, PR, hosted, or release gates.
Creating a separate process-repair Work Item for a defect that this scope can correct.
Publishing a release, merging a PR, deleting branches, or changing GitHub runner/provider settings outside this Work Item lifecycle.

riskAssessment.reason: A false candidate binding could authorize archival of untested code or silently absorb another Work Item's dirty state; evidence must remain immutable and fail closed.
riskAssessment.unknownsReviewReason: The #672 forensic record, #680 successor acceptance, existing candidate checker, archive transaction, and focused regressions define the technical boundary. The remaining implementation choice is test-constrained engineering, not an unresolved human decision.

reasons: Archive integrity, coverage enforcement, and immutable evidence require strict verification.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorization, #680 scope, #672 forensic record, predecessor evidence, acceptance, and verification plan are explicit.

preReviewWarnings: Review candidate identity for content rather than path-only status, including staged, unstaged, deleted, renamed, and untracked paths.
Review that only Contract-owned paths may contribute to the candidate and that the same successful evidence is preserved in Outcome and manifest.
Review that archive retries cannot reuse stale coverage evidence after any candidate mutation.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The pre-archive changed-critical gate builds a deterministic candidate snapshot from Contract base, HEAD, staged, unstaged, deleted, renamed, and untracked Work Item content without creating an ordinary commit before archive.
The gate rejects an ambiguous base, unreadable candidate content, or dirty path outside the active Contract scope before running coverage or archive mutation.
A passing coverage result is bound to candidate tree/diff digest and recorded in active Summary/derived Outcome before archive; archive rejects missing, stale, or mismatched evidence.
The immutable archive manifest records candidate coverage binding and result digest alongside Contract, Summary, and Outcome digests.
Focused regressions cover a successful uncommitted candidate, changed content with unchanged status, staged/untracked content, foreign dirty paths, stale evidence, and manifest persistence.
Lifecycle documentation and generated capability/pre-release evidence describe the exact fail-closed boundary without claiming an ordinary pre-archive commit.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The candidate snapshot and coverage result include the exact changed bytes, not only `<base>...HEAD` or a path-only status digest.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a focused checker regression that changes bytes without changing the path set and asserts the candidate digest changes.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add candidate-snapshot tests for index and untracked content.

guidelines: Preserve immutable historical archive evidence byte-for-byte; add only new evidence for this Work Item.
Use deterministic, content-addressed candidate data; never authorize archive from a path-only status digest.
Fail closed on foreign or ambiguous worktree state instead of inferring ownership or applying a temporary bypass.
Keep generated capability and documentation evidence synchronized with implementation and tests.

intent.problem: #672 found that the #668 pre-archive gate could pass while inspecting `<base>...HEAD` plus only a path-level worktree digest. Canonical archive happens before the Work Item commit, so the gate lacked proof of the actual uncommitted bytes it was about to freeze; its result was also not rooted in the archive manifest.
constraints: Do not amend or rewrite frozen #672 or historical archives.
Do not create an ordinary commit before archive solely to make coverage inspectable.
Do not weaken coverage thresholds, scope ownership, archive integrity, or Outcome requirements.
Correct every discovered process defect that is within this Work Item's declared scope.
intent.rationale: A deterministic candidate snapshot makes coverage evidence verifiable against exact pre-archive bytes, while strict ownership checks prevent unrelated work from being silently captured. Carrying its digest into Outcome and archive manifest gives later PR/release audits one immutable chain.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user gave standing authorization to execute the remaining plan automatically, record authority in each Contract, fix process defects in the current Work Item, and avoid temporary bypasses; this explicitly covers the required restricted changed-critical coverage policy mapping.

rollbackNote: Revert only this Work Item diff and regenerate source-bound documentation evidence. Do not modify #672 or any historical archive while rolling back.
